findings.finding: The consensus rows are a pre-results snapshot (Alpha Vantage, retrieved 2026-10-26, before the 2026-10-28 Q3 print). FY2026 revenue 35.66B and EPS 2.69 sit below the company's own new guide (36.9-37.1B, Adjusted EPS 2.82-2.84). The metric is labelled eps_diluted, but AV does not state the basis; it is most likely adjusted, not GAAP. The post-print refresh was rate limited, so no current consensus exists. Any expectation-gap or 'vs consensus' reading built on these rows understates the market's expectation.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json consensus nm_cons_eps_fy2026, nm_cons_revenue_fy2026, nm_cons_eps_fy2027, nm_cons_revenue_fy2027, nm_cons_eps_q4_2026, nm_cons_revenue_q4_2026 (source nm_av_estimates)
findings.fix: Keep the rows, label them 'pre-Q3-print, basis unstated (likely adjusted)', and relabel metric eps_diluted to adjusted_eps_basis_unstated. Next to the result, say that consensus is stale and below guidance. Do not use these rows as the market expectation without that caveat. Refresh after the AV quota resets if a rerun happens.

findings.finding: The price is dated wrongly and its basis is not the close. The IBKR snapshot ts 1793403567 is Fri 2026-10-30 23:39 UTC, which is after hours (is_close false). The source and fact are dated 2026-10-31, a Saturday. The official month-end close in the lane's own history bar is 79.30, against 79.47 used. The SPLIT note also still quotes a stale 'IBKR last 74.31' from the earlier run.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json source nm_px_ib (date 2026-10-31), fact nm_price_last_2026_10_31; notes entry 'nm SPLIT ...'
findings.fix: Date the price 2026-10-30 and use the 2026-10-30 close (79.30 per nm_ib_history), or label 79.47 as an after-hours last trade. Remove or update the 74.31 in the SPLIT note. The value impact is about 0.2%.

findings.finding: Some share counts are labelled basis 'reported' but are split-adjusted derivations. The 10-Q cover of 2026-07-31 reports 1,232,983,457 shares, while documents.json records 2,465,966,914 (x2). The 2026-10-30 10-Q cover's actual post-split count, 2,469,261,188 at 2026-10-27, is already in dc_fact_shares_out_20261027. The numbers lane's market-cap note uses the older 2,465.97M.
findings.where: gather/documents.json fact dc_fact_shares_out_20260728 (basis reported); gather/numbers.json notes 'nm PRICE ...' market cap
findings.fix: Set the dc_fact_shares_out_20260728 basis to derived (x2 split, nm_8k_20260904), or drop it as superseded. Use dc_fact_shares_out_20261027 (2,469,261,188) for point-in-time ownership and market cap.

findings.finding: Per-share guidance and EPS items are stored on the post-2026-split basis but are not marked as derived. The 2026-07-29 release says Q3 Adjusted EPS guidance of $1.40-1.42 and CommScope accretion of $0.30 (prior $0.15). The 2026-01-28 release says $0.15. The fragment stores 0.70-0.71, 0.15 and 0.075 under those releases, so a reader tracing the cited document finds different numbers. The same applies to dc_fact_adj_eps_q2_2026 0.675 (release: 1.35), dc_fact_adj_eps_q4_2025 0.485 and dc_fact_adj_eps_q2_2025 0.405. The guidance_track EPS rows instead stay on the pre-split basis (Q3 mid 1.41, actual 1.60 = 0.80 x 2). The basis is consistent inside each table, but it differs between fragments.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_guid_q3_adj_eps, dc_guid_commscope_eps_fy26, dc_guid_commscope_eps_fy26_prior; facts dc_fact_adj_eps_q2_2026, dc_fact_adj_eps_q4_2025, dc_fact_adj_eps_q2_2025; gather/numbers.json guidance_track adjusted_eps rows
findings.fix: Add a basis note to each item ('split-adjusted /2 from the release's $X; 2-for-1 split 2026-09-02') or set basis derived. Keep the track-record EPS ratio on one stated basis.

findings.finding: Superseded CommScope guidance stays alongside the current guide with no superseded marker. Two items carry the same metric and period: dc_guid_commscope_sales_fy26 at 4.6B (2026-07-29) and dc_guid_commscope_sales_fy26_oct at 5.1B (2026-10-28), and likewise for accretion 0.15 vs 0.18.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_guid_commscope_sales_fy26, dc_guid_commscope_eps_fy26 (and the _prior items)
findings.fix: Mark the July and January items as superseded history (or move them to notes) so that only the 2026-10-28 items (5.1B, 0.18) count as the current FY2026 guide.
